_comment: Every real detail on the website comes from this file. Anything wrapped in [square brackets] is a placeholder waiting for your information - search the built site for '[' to find any you have missed. Change a value here, run `python build.py`, and it updates on every page.
tagline: Where girls play, grow and belong.
default_description: A volunteer-led cricket academy for girls. Come and learn the game, make friends, and find out what you can do. No experience needed.
cost_line: [Free for the first term, then a small subscription - and nobody is turned away over cost]
kit_line: [Comfortable sports clothes and trainers. We lend out bats, pads and helmets.]
_form_comment: The forms POST here. Paste a Formspree, Basin, Netlify or Google Forms endpoint. Left empty, forms fall back to opening the visitor's email app so nothing is ever lost.
